---
title: "uv-python invalid multiple captioned table events"
engine: uv-python
format: html
---

```{python}
#| label: tbl-too-many-events
#| tbl-cap: This should fail because two separate table display events are emitted
from uv_python_runtime import display, Markdown

display(Markdown("""
| first | value |
| --- | ---: |
| a | 1 |
"""))

display(Markdown("""
| second | value |
| --- | ---: |
| b | 2 |
"""))
```
